coverage.note: Current national candidates page lists Maine only for Troy Jackson (US Senate, out of scope); /state/maine/ is 404. No 2022 or 2024 archive and no 2022 or 2026 governor endorsement page was found, so those cycles are unchecked. Web search found only Platner (US Senate, 2026) and 2018 governor endorsements.

The ME category holds only 2026 items (three legislative; Dunlap ME-02 and Jackson US Senate are out of scope), so no 2022 or 2024 Maine entries and no governor entry were found. Local Our Revolution groups in Maine were not enumerated.

Maine DSA is the only Maine chapter. Its endorsements page lists only 2024 to 2026 items (none for the legislature before 2026). 2022 and earlier-cycle legislative and governor endorsements unchecked: electoral.dsausa.org past-endorsements returned 403.

Static directory pages show five Maine cards but may be partial (saved notes: RFS 2026 count unreconciled, name variants and release-only candidacies unreviewed). RFS does not endorse governors. Special elections not checked.

2022, 2024 and 2026 endorsement pages and the 2022 champions list show no Maine state-office entries (only Troy Jackson, US Senate 2026, out of scope). The 2020 champion Thomas Harnett (HD83) is out of scope and a champions list alone is not an endorsement. Web search found no PCCC governor endorsement.

Saved notes show one Maine hub (Franklin County) with only an Instagram presence, which is inaccessible. No national Sunrise endorsement list was checked for any cycle, nor was any governor endorsement.

gaps: Maine SOS pages blocked (HTTP 403 to automated fetch): https://www.maine.gov/sos/cec/elec/results/index.html, https://www.maine.gov/sos/cec/elec/results/results22.html, https://www.maine.gov/sos/cec/elec/results/results26.html. The 2024 results page was not requested. All results therefore cite Ballotpedia; 2026 figures are unofficial and uncertified.
Senate term rule text (Art. IV, Part Second) not retrieved from an official page; Senate dates for Reny rely on the House rule plus Ballotpedia.

contact_url: Sato, Osher and Golek use their legislature.maine.gov profile pages. The roster still lists the 131st Legislature (e.g. HD121 Christopher Kessler), so service for the 2026 term rests on the constitutional rule only.
Endorsement dates unknown for RFS 2022 and 2024 cards and for Lucy Perkins (DSA); stage set to general.

Governor 2022 and 2026: no endorsement found beyond DSA for Jackson, but WFP and Sunrise sources for those cycles were not available (see coverage). Web searches found no OR, PCCC, Sunrise or WFP governor endorsement.
Special elections since 2022 were not checked for any group.
